meta.mo_ta: Khoang tham chieu dung cho cot T (Tong phan tich te bao mau) va cac nhan xet CTM. Da duoc Jo xac nhan lai 30/09/2026 bang phieu Ket Qua Xet Nghiem thuc te (BN Tran Hue An, mau LIS41199905, Tong phan tich te bao mau ngoai vi) - cac nguong khop hoan toan voi ban truoc, nay chinh thuc DUYET.
meta.nguon: Phieu Ket Qua Xet Nghiem thuc te - Tram Y te Phuong Nhieu Loc, BN Tran Hue An, mau benh pham 5085/LIS41199905, lay mau 22/08/2026 (anh Jo gui 30/09/2026)

don_vi_nguon_m03_mac_dinh._ghi_chu_hb: Cot 'Huyet sac to' trong file M03 ghi nhan (g/L) o header nhung so lieu thuc te nhap vao co dang g/dL (vd 13,6 - 14,4). Tram phai tu khai bao lai don vi thuc te dang dung trong o cau hinh giao dien neu khac.

hb._ghi_chu: Phieu minh hoa chi cho MOT khoang chung cho nguoi lon, chua tach theo gioi/tuoi/thai ky. Dung chung nam & nu_khong_thai. nu_mang_thai va khac de null -> ung dung se tra ve 'Chua du nguong de nhan xet Hb' cho nhung nhom nay cho den khi duoc cau hinh rieng va duyet.

rbc._ghi_chu: Hong cau (so luong hong cau, cot kskdk_xnm_slhc). Nguong Jo xac nhan qua chat 01/10/2026 ("nguong 3,5 - 6,0"), CHUA doi chieu voi phieu xet nghiem thuc te nhu Hb/MCV/WBC/PLT - neu sau nay Jo gui phieu thuc te co so khac thi cap nhat lai.

thieu_mau_qd1613._ghi_chu: QD 1613/BYT-QD (15/08/1997), chi tieu 50.5 'Thieu mau nang thuong xuyen', huong dan muc 14: xac dinh bang cong thuc mau, hong cau duoi 3 trieu (3.0 T/L) VA huyet sac to duoi 10 g/100ml (10 g/dL). Bang phan loai danh dau loai III-IV. QD 1613 KHONG co nguong cho thieu mau nhe/vua.

thieu_mau_qd1832._ghi_chu: CAP NHAT 11/11/2026 (yeu cau Jo): danh gia thieu mau PHAN TANG 2 MUC, ket hop moc theo gioi (thieu_mau_hb: nam 130, nu 120 g/L) voi nguong tham chieu Hb tren phieu xet nghiem (nguong.hb: 11.0 g/dL = 110 g/L). Hb < 110 g/L -> Thieu mau, muc do theo QD 1832/QD-BYT (07/01/2022): nhe 90-<110, vua 60-<90, nang 30-<60, rat nang <30 g/L. 110 <= Hb < moc theo gioi (nam 130 / nu 120) -> Theo doi thieu mau. Hb >= moc theo gioi -> khong ghi. Truong ty_le_giam_so_voi_tham_chieu (5%) KHONG con duoc dung - giu lai de tham khao.

thieu_mau_hb._ghi_chu: Nguong RIENG (theo gioi tinh, don vi g/L) de tu dong ghi 'Theo dõi thiếu máu' vao cot DANH GIA khi Hb (quy doi ve g/dL roi nhan 10 de so sanh) THAP HON nguong nay - yeu cau + nguong Jo xac nhan qua chat 01/10/2026 ("Nam: Hb <130 g/L; Nữ: Hb <120 g/L"). KHAC voi nguong.hb o tren (don vi g/dL, dung rieng cho Canh bao CTM 'Hb giảm/tăng', da duyet 30/09/2026 tu phieu xet nghiem thuc te, khong gioi han theo gioi tinh) - 2 nguong nay dung cho 2 muc dich khac nhau, KHONG gop chung.
